title: Bill Uhouse: Kingman-based simulator and J-Rod

tellings.quote: who claimed at Area 51 auxiliary sites, there was basically a a ARV or extraterrestrial vehicle simulator built off the Kingman crash

plain: At outlying sites around Area 51, the secret Nevada test base, there was a simulator of an alien craft built from the wreck of the Kingman crash, a UFO crash said to have happened near Kingman, Arizona. That was the claim of a man named Bill Uhouse, and a researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb repeats it to Michels. If true, it would mean engineers were training people to fly a recovered craft.
